reviews.comment: While I found his lectures hard to follow and a little disorganized at first, I quickly got used to them, especially since he posts his lecture notes online which are much better organized. All his resources are online and he has plenty of material to help you study for exams. He is also very nice and understanding. Definitely reccomend.

Peyam is leaving A&M for Brown but for all looking--TAKE PEYAM! He will be the best math prof of your whole college career. He provides amazing notes online (and videos on his YouTube for this and other subjects) that make class skippable HOWEVER his teaching style makes it worth going to class. Best prof ever.

FANTASTIC PROF, if you are a brown student reading this TAKE HIM. He is amazing, you can literally skip lecture his notes are THAT great. You really will understand the concepts well. He is my favorite professor and I am so happy I got to take him for Diff Eq

He truly cares about his class and that shows through his teaching and course management. The material that is covered can be difficult but he makes it as easy as possible to understand. Despite all of his lecture notes being available online, it is worth showing up to class. Always responding to emails quickly. Office hours are a great resource.

Peyam is awesome! Took him for MATH251 and taking him in MATH308 now. He's super knowledgeable and passionate. He's got a great sense of humor and is super personable during class and in office hours. Exams are very similar to his provided practice tests. Decent amount of homework but it's doable. He posts all his notes in great detail.

This guy is better than JD and that is saying something. Absolute pleasure to have as a prof, very personable and just the right amount of weird. Very knowledgeable and LOVES teaching math. Exam reviews and practice exams are make the exams a breeze. Lecture notes are always available but you don't want to miss everything he brings to a lecture!!!

Dr. Peyam's lectures are informative but still approachable, with amazing typeset notes to accompany them. His YouTube channel is also a helpful resource for review. While there's a lot of homework, it's great exam practice -- some questions show up almost verbatim. Inside and outside of class, he makes it clear that he's always on your side.

Peyam's corny jokes, personality, and overall energy make his lectures so much more interesting than other professors. He doesn't record lectures but makes his notes available online. They sometimes miss minor details but are still extremely helpful 80% of the course grade is covered by exams. The exams aren't trivial but aren't *too* hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Peyam is super caring, funny, and passionate about what he does, however, this class was miserable. As someone who relies heavily on the homework to reinforce my learning, I really struggled since the homework was almost completely disconnected from lecture, quizzes, and exams. This was sadly the first math class at TAMU I really struggled with.

He is the best of the best when it comes to professors. He not only cares that you pass but will give you every resource possible to do so. He responds to emails fast, and posts notes online. His personality is unmatched. He brings a level of energy to lecture which I've never seen before. Easily the best professor for 251.

I literally made an account just to give this review. He genuinely cares about the class, makes amazing lecture notes, gives tons of study materials for the tests, and makes lectures interesting. The gets progressively more difficult but if you put in the effort Peyam gives you all the materials you need to succeed. 11/10 HIGHLY recommend.
This professor is very passionate about what he does. He's great at outlining steps to solutions and peppering in ways to make the class laugh in his lectures. He truly cares about his students.

Dr Peyam is an incredibly passionate professor that makes sure that his students have the resources needed to succeed. 251 is a hard class and can be confusing at times, but Dr Peyam made the experience much easier. The only issue I even had with the course was something out of his control, and it is definitely very possible to get an A.

Best professor you can take for cal 3. Great lectures and easily accessible outside of class. Not an easy class due to the requirements of the math department but peyam does a great job of teaching and POSTING HIS LECTURE NOTES. His notes are very helpful and are great for reviewing/studying.
